notes: Tail case, all units re-examined. U1 mask was a coarse blob over awning/wall; re-segmented to the tall potted plant (v2) with a clear colour value. U2 ref names the round VIET DREAM TRAVEL sign and replace made structural. U3 tiny ambiguous window retargeted to the unique guitar-shaped sign (v2). U4 ref fixed to the black HOTEL sign with green letters and payload made natural.
